text:
maria: Quick sync — product just escalated a customer ask: reduce tail latency for chat workloads (8k context, mixed bursty traffic). PM wants a prioritized plan + PRD + launch criteria by EOD Friday. Who can draft acceptance criteria?
sam: I can start a draft. Key acceptance: p99 latency <= 250ms for 8k context at target qps on Dedicated, no regression in top-1 token KL on eval set (>99% of baseline). Also define fallback behavior.
june: +1. Need to call out memory footprint and KV cache eviction policies. If we change kernel selection heuristics, eviction churn could spike. Acceptance should include kv-miss rate <= X for our repro workload.
ash: tagging infra: if kernel variant increases GPU memory by >10% we need autoscale knobs and rollout rollback fast path.
maria: Good point. Product also wants a canary plan that tests with the named customer and one internal org. Keep rollout to <= 5% traffic initially.
sam: Draft checklist I'm proposing: 1) Perf matrix (p50/p95/p99) across seq lens and batch sizes, 2) Quality regression tests (eval prompts + adversarial), 3) Resource delta (mem/latency/cost), 4) Canary plan + rollback triggers, 5) Ops runbook.
nina: Ops ask: add explicit SLO for KV eviction-induced OOMs = 0 over 30d during canary. Also include trace sampling config to help debug KV churn.
june: Edge cases: 1) very long prefixes with sparse recency -> KV cache growth, 2) multi-tenant GPU sharing with mixed quantization types, 3) model variant mismatch between routing table and serving nodes. Need acceptance for each.
sam: For rollout triggers: abort if p99 increases by >20% vs baseline, or quality metric drops >1.5% absolute. Fallback should be immediate switch to prior kernel and drain new sessions.
maria: Product asks for cost delta estimate. Sam, can you add expected token cost delta and RMB (relative monthly bill) for Dedicated and Hosted?
sam: Will add. Quick note on experiments: let's bake a small A/B that routes identical requests to old/new kernel inside same cluster (shadow) and compare outputs + perf. No customer-facing risk.
dev-bot: deploybot: canary job started for runtime/kernels/variant-B on cluster-prod-3 — build #2026
ash: Ops: when we run canary, ensure we have data retention for traces for at least 7 days and alerting on p99 regression. Also schedule a warroom for the first 2 hours of canary.
nina: QA: will create a focused eval set of 2k prompts that are chatty, include function calls and long context. We'll run diff and CLI checks.
maria: OK, action items: Sam — PRD draft + acceptance criteria; Nina — eval set; June — KV eviction test plan; Nash — canary infra + autoscale knobs; I'll coordinate customer outreach and set canary windows.
sam: I'll upload PRD draft to /docs/prd/kernel-tail-latency-draft and post link here when ready.
maria: Thanks everyone. If you want something added to acceptance, ping me. We'll review Wed 10am. :thumbsup:
